body: 为原创故事《星港来信》画角色关系图。3:4竖版浅米白背景，清晰节点肖像和定向箭头。顶部标题“星港来信”。三个人物节点：顶端青年女飞行员“林夏”，左下男机械师“陈舟”，右下女航海员“苏月”。林夏和陈舟之间双向连线标“搭档”；林夏指向苏月的箭头标“寻找”；陈舟指向苏月的箭头标“兄妹”。人物不重叠，三个关系标签各一次，无额外人物和文字。

## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. This example uses no reference image.

## Observed result

Three named portraits form a clear triangle. Partner, search and sibling labels connect the intended characters; the partner relationship has two directions.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 33. [Source](https://github.com/ZeroLu/awesome-gpt-image/blob/main/README.md#key-character-relationship-map). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.
